description: This file defines the PersonName class in the org.openmrs package, representing a person's name with various components (given name, family name, etc.), including methods for management, comparison, and formatting of person names within the OpenMRS healthcare system.

classes.name: PersonName
classes.description: Represents a person's name with components such as given name, family name, middle name, prefix, suffix, and associated methods for formatting, comparison, and data management.

classes.name: PersonName.DefaultComparator
classes.description: A comparator class for comparing two PersonName objects, considering parameters like voided status, preferred flag, family names, given name, middle name, and creation date.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Concatenates name components into a formatted full name string based on user or system-defined templates or constants, handling special formatting based on configuration.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Implements comparison logic for ordering PersonName objects, respecting voided status, preference, family names, given and middle names, and creation date.
